# WellData Partners

> Data architecture and machine learning consulting for upstream oil & gas operators. We help E&P companies reduce OPEX and eliminate non-productive time (NPT) through edge-to-cloud infrastructure, predictive analytics, and digital twin design.

WellData Partners is a specialized consulting firm focused on the digital transformation of upstream petroleum operations. We build the data infrastructure that connects field sensors to boardroom decisions — from IIoT sensor integration and Unified Namespace (UNS) design at the edge, to cloud-based ML models for predictive maintenance, artificial lift optimization, and reservoir analytics.

Our clients are upstream operators in unconventional and mature conventional basins who need to reduce lifting costs, extend asset life, and improve production performance without the overhead of large internal data teams. We are fluent in both the operational realities of the field and the technical depth of modern data engineering.

## Services

- **Edge-to-Cloud Data Architecture**: IIoT sensor integration, protocol conversion (Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC-UA, MQTT), Unified Namespace design, edge computing for remote field environments. Enables real-time data from every well, pump, and compressor without cloud dependency.
- **Predictive Operations & Maintenance**: ML models for failure prediction in artificial lift systems (ESPs, rod pumps, gas lift), anomaly detection, frac fleet optimization. Typical result: 30–50% reduction in unplanned workovers.
- **Reservoir & Production Analytics**: Digital twin design, production optimization, waterflood management, well interference analysis, diluent optimization (heavy oil). Enables data-driven decisions on injection patterns, lift settings, and production allocation.
- **ESG Data Infrastructure**: Real-time flaring measurement, methane leak detection, Scope 1/2 emissions reporting, pipeline integrity monitoring. Converts ESG compliance from a cost center into a capital markets advantage.
